content: Dɑfidin womu ɡe u wom kowobun wiruɡii kuɑ. Ge wee.

content.text: Wɔllu kɑ kperi yi Gusunɔn yiiko sɔ̃ɔsimɔ.
Sɔ̃ɔ kɑ suru bɑ Gusunɔn bɛɛrɛ sɔ̃ɔsimɔ.
Kɑ win nɔmɑ u sɑɑbɑ yi yi.
Tɔ̃ru bɑɑtere tɑ ten seedɑ dimɔ.
Wɔ̃kuru bɑɑtere tɑ ten ɑreru dimɔ.
Adɑmɑ n ǹ kɑ nɔɔ ɡɑɡu,
n ǹ kɑ ɡɑri ɡɛɛ,
n ǹ kɑ bɑrum ɡɑm.
Kɑ mɛ, bɑ yiiko yen seedɑ nɔɔmɔ hɑnduniɑ kpuro sɔɔ.
Bɑ ye mɛɛrɑ hɑnduniɑn ɡoonu nnɛ sɔɔ.
A sɔ̃ɔ mɛɛrio.
Wɔllu miyɑ Gusunɔ u nùn wɑ̃ɑ yeru kuɑ.
Ù n yɑrɑ u rɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe kurɔ kpɑon durɔ.
Ù n sĩimɔ u rɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe tɑbu durɔ.
U rɑ yɑriwɑ wɔllun bee tiɑ,
kpɑ u du berɑ ɡiɔ.
Ù n sĩimɔ, ɡɑ̃ɑnu sɑri ni nu koo win yɑm susuru suuri.
Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi yibɑ.
Yi rɑ tɔnu wɑ̃ɑru kɑ dɑm wɛ̃.
Yinni Gusunɔn nɔɔn ɡɑri yi nɑɑnɛ mɔ.
Yi rɑ yɛ̃ru sɑriruɡii bwisi kɛ̃.
Yinni Gusunɔn ɡere yɑ dɛnde.
Yɑ rɑ tɔnu nuku dobu wɛ̃.
Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃ɔsiru tɑ dɛɛre.
Tɑ rɑ tɔnu yɑm wɑɑsie.
Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑru tɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡem.
Tɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Ye Yinni Gusunɔ u yi, yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ dee dee,
yɑ rɑ tɔmbu kpuro siriwɑ.
Domi win ɡɑri yi wurɑ ɡeɑ kere.
Win ɡere yɑ tim ɡɔm dobu kere.
Nɑ̀ n win ɡɑri yi swĩi,
yi rɑ mɑn kirɔ ko.
Nɑ̀ n win woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑ,
nɑ rɑ yen ɑrufɑɑni wɑ.
Kɑ yen de kpuro tɔnu koo kpĩ u win torɑnu kpuro tubu?
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ mɑn dɛɛrɑsio nɛn torɑ ni nɑ ǹ tubɑn di.
A ku mɑɑ de n durum ko kɑ deɡɑnɡɑm.
A ku de yu mɑn dɔɔrɛ ko,
kpɑ nɑ n durum bɑkɑn tɑɑrɛ mɔ.
Adɑmɑ ɑ de nɑ n dɛɛre.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ de ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nɛn kuku yeru.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ mɑn fɑɑbɑ koowo durum kpuron di.
A de nɛn ɡɑri yi nun wɛ̃re.
A de nɛn bwisikunu nu nun wɛ̃re.
